title: Warehouse-Loss Claim Ceiling and Seller Performance Standing (FBN)
content:
**Adjudication standard.** For a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss case, the warehouse-loss claim ceiling is waived for a seller whose performance standing level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level; for a seller at Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level it is the units of the largest single lost-in-warehouse inventory adjustment ever recorded for the SKU; for a seller at Standard Level or Above Standard Level this standard does not alter the ceiling.

The level is the seller's current level on the Seller Performance Standing record.

## By level

| Seller Performance Standing level | Warehouse-loss claim ceiling |
|---|---|
| Preferred Partner Level | waived: no claim ceiling applies, and the ceiling equals the uncapped remainder |
| Top Rated Level | waived, as above |
| Above Standard Level | not altered by this standard |
| Standard Level | not altered by this standard |
| Developing Seller Level | units of the largest single lost-in-warehouse adjustment ever recorded for the SKU |
| Below Standard Level | units of the largest single lost-in-warehouse adjustment ever recorded for the SKU |

## Points of judgement

- **"Ever recorded."** The largest single adjustment is taken over the whole history of the SKU's lost-in-warehouse adjustments, with no time limit; it is one adjustment's units, never a sum.
- **Waived ceiling.** For Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level the ceiling is the uncapped remainder itself — the lost units remaining after found units and earlier lost-in-warehouse reimbursements are deducted.

Illustration (hypothetical): a Developing Seller Level seller whose SKU has lost-in-warehouse adjustments of 7 units fourteen months ago and 3 units last month has a ceiling of 7 units. A Top Rated Level seller with a remainder of 22 units has a ceiling of 22.
